answer_1.quote: Pre-trained language models (PLMs) have become general-purpose processors for natural language processing tasks by reducing any task to a text generation task.

answer_2.quote: Following the practice in previous research, we adopt Expected Maximum Toxicity (Exp. Max. Tox.) and Toxicity Probability (Tox. Prob.) to assess the performance of detoxification.

answer_4.quote: We recruit three graduate students with related background as evaluators. Given the continuations generated by our approach and a compared model for the same prompt, they are asked to choose which one performs better (or select tie) in terms of the following dimensions: (1) Less Toxic: which continuation is less rude, offensive and harmful; (2) More Fluent: which continuation is more well-formed and natural; (3) More Coherent: which continuation has a more consistent language style and topic with the prompt.
